fields.title: NeST tender/award/contract record
fields.description: One record per Open Contracting (OCDS) record from Tanzania's NeST e-Procurement system, produced by mode=list (a page of recent records starting from a date) or mode=detail (one specific OCID). Both modes emit the same shape: a handful of convenience summary fields pulled up to the top, plus the full upstream 'compiledRelease' (tender/awards/contracts/parties, verbatim) and the 'releases' history array. A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a record can't be fetched.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: 'list:since=<date>'. For detail records: the OCID that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which strategy emitted this record (S1-records-list, S1-records-detail, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (blocked_or_transient, not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

ocid.title: OCID
ocid.description: The Open Contracting ID -- NeST's stable identifier for this procurement process, stable across its whole tender -> award -> contract lifecycle.

tenderId.title: Tender ID
tenderId.description: The procuring entity's own tender reference number.

procurementMethodDetails.title: Procurement method details
procurementMethodDetails.description: Free-text procedure name, e.g. 'National Shopping -Lower Level (Mini Competition Quotation)'.

buyerName.title: Buyer name
buyerName.description: The government buyer named on the record.

procuringEntityName.title: Procuring entity name
procuringEntityName.description: The procuring entity running this procurement (usually the same as buyerName).

recordDate.title: Record date
recordDate.description: The compiled record's own 'date' field -- generally its most recent event date.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: OCDS release tags present on this compiled record (e.g. ['compiled']).

awardsCount.title: Awards count
awardsCount.description: Number of award entries on this record.

contractsCount.title: Contracts count
contractsCount.description: Number of contract entries on this record.

totalAwardAmount.title: Total award amount
totalAwardAmount.description: Sum of all award value amounts on this record, when present.

awardCurrency.title: Award currency
awardCurrency.description: Currency code for totalAwardAmount, e.g. TZS.

compiledRelease.title: Compiled release (full detail)
compiledRelease.description: The complete upstream OCDS compiledRelease object verbatim -- includes tender (with line items), parties, awards, contracts, buyer, and more. Field set varies by procurement type and stage; passed through as-is rather than enumerated field-by-field.

releases.title: Release history
releases.description: The list of individual OCDS release events (tender, tenderUpdate, award, contract, ...) that were compiled into this record, each with its own URL and date.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across list and detail records -- rows missing a given column render blank.
